ja: 鎧　袖　一　触
黒 衣 大 鎧 纏 い て
い ざ 、 出 陣 の 刻
「MG 1/100 真武者頑駄無 戦国の陣」が、ガンプラオリジナルカラーにて装いを新たに商品化。
特徴的な大鎧を黒を基調としたカラーリングに一新。新規描き下ろしの屏風や彼岸花をあしらった和柄のシールが付属。
●　オリジナルカラー“黒衣大鎧”を纏い見参！
黒を基調とした大鎧のカラーリングを成形色で一新。
赤い外装部はメッキ加工を施し、シルバーの外装部にはメタリック成形色を採用。装備類も本体カラーに合わせた配色で再現！
●　特殊素材「和シール」が付属
和紙のような加工を施した「和スタイルオリジナルステッカー」が付属。妖しく煌く彼岸花をあしらった新規柄を収録。
●　豪華“陣”を飾る多彩な装飾品が付属
節句仕様の各種武器を展示する台座やスタンド類、屏風や木札風ネームプレートなど多彩な装飾品が付属。
森下直親氏描き下ろし“銀屏風”が同梱！
数々のガンプラボックスアートを手掛ける森下直親氏描き下ろしの屏風絵シートが付属。
龍と鳳凰が描かれた屏風絵シートには銀の箔押し加工が施され、重厚感ある“銀屏風”を再現。
木札風ネームプレートは新規筆文字デザインの箔押しシールで再現！
●　新規デザインフルカラーパッケージでお届け！
〈セット内容〉： 真武者頑駄無 戦国の陣 黒衣大鎧 ／ 太刀 ／ 火砲 ／ 槍 ／ 薙刀

en: armor sleeve one touch
Wearing black clothes and large armor
It's time to go to battle
"MG 1/100 Shinmusha Gundam Sengoku Jin" has been commercialized with a new look in Gunpla original colors.
The characteristic large armor has been redesigned to a black-based coloring. Comes with a newly drawn folding screen and a Japanese-patterned Seal featuring red spider lilies.
●Visit wearing the original color “Kuroi Ooiro”!
The coloring of the large armor, which is based on black, has been renewed with molding colors.
The red exterior part is plated, and the silver exterior part uses metallic molding color. The equipment is also reproduced in a color scheme that matches the main body color!
● Comes with special material "Wa Seal"
Comes with a "Japanese style original sticker" that has been processed to look like Japanese paper. Contains a new pattern featuring mysteriously sparkling spider lilies.
● Comes with a variety of decorations to decorate the luxurious "camp"
Includes a variety of accessories such as pedestals and stands for displaying various seasonal weapons, folding screens, and wooden name plates.
A “silver folding screen” drawn by Naochika Morishita is included!
Includes a folding screen picture sheet drawn by Naochika Morishita, who has created many Gunpla box art pieces.
The folding screen picture sheet depicting a dragon and a phoenix is ​​stamped with silver foil to recreate the profound feeling of a "silver folding screen."
The wooden name plate is reproduced with a foil-stamped seal with a new calligraphy design!
● Delivered in a newly designed full color package!
〈Set contents〉: Shinmusha Gundam Sengoku no Jin Black Clothes Armor / Long Sword / Artillery / Spear / Naginata
／ Decorative pedestal ／ Folding screen ／ Wooden name plate ／ Stand (for spears and naginata, for firearms and long swords)
1/100 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Product material: PS/PE/PP/ABS
・No adhesive is used for assembly
・This kit requires a + (Plus) screwdriver (sold separately).
